notes: There are 18 endpoints. 14 are new routes from system-design §2.5. 4 are existing routes that get extended: GET /api/attendance/today (noSchoolReason), GET /api/attendance/register (noSchoolReason), PUT /api/attendance/register (holidayOverride, D-8) and POST /api/internal/email/dispatch (sendRsvpReminders). There are also 4 non-HTTP contracts: getUpcomingEventsForUser, getPublicEvents, isSchoolDay and the notification types.

The base path is /api, not /api/v1. Envelopes and error codes come from src/server/http.ts, where VALIDATION_ERROR maps to 400. The feed, the single-event .ics and the RSVP CSV return raw bodies. An unknown feed token returns 404 text/plain.

Error policy: an event the caller cannot see, or a studentId they cannot view, returns 404. Not the creator, an admin-only field, a disallowed audience, or not in the audience returns 403 with details.reason. RSVP disabled or closed returns 409. Rate limits return 429 with details.retryAfterMs and Retry-After.

Decisions made beyond system-design: all-day input is startDate/endDate (yyyy-MM-dd, inclusive end) and output is an exclusive UTC end. audiences is limited to 1..20 entries. rsvpDeadline must be ≤ the first occurrence's start. Occurrence ids are '<eventId>:<startISO>', and all /api/events/:id routes take the plain eventId. GET /api/attendance/register also gains noSchoolReason (system-design names only getToday/getOverview). Term breaks send no event.created notifications and return {created, skipped, events}. The dispatch summary gains rsvpReminders {events, notified}.

Carried risks from system-design §4: R1 beta @mui/x-scheduler API drift (exact pin, MUI MCP lookup is mandatory, NFR-2), R2 import cycle (calendar-service must never import timetable-service), R3 DST across 4 code paths, R4 audience resolver parity test.
